scripts.build: bun build --compile src/index.ts --outfile dist/anima-watchdog && bun run sign
scripts.deploy: bun run build && mkdir -p "${ANIMA_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.anima}/bin" && install -m 700 dist/anima-watchdog "${ANIMA_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.anima}/bin/watchdog" && echo "Deployed to ${ANIMA_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.anima}/bin/watchdog (reload its LaunchAgent to pick it up)"
